lines: Battle of Rivermarch (plains). Thornmane Clans (attacking) with the Thornmane Clans army at Rivermarch (4 units, no commander); Aurel Crown (defending) with the Aurel Crown army at Rivermarch (4 units, no commander).
Round 1: Thornmane Clans dealt 8 damage (2 of 4 hits), Aurel Crown dealt 18 damage (4 of 4 hits). Thornmane Clans' Fangthrowers fell.

Round 2: Thornmane Clans dealt 4 damage (1 of 3 hits), Aurel Crown dealt 14 damage (3 of 4 hits). Thornmane Clans' Fangthrowers fell. Aurel Crown's Spearmen fell. Thornmane Clans broke and fled after losing 55% of its strength (morale 7 holds only to 55%).
Casualties: Thornmane Clans lost 2 of 4 fighters, and the other 2 fled; Aurel Crown lost 1 of 4 fighters.
Hits: Thornmane Clans hit 43% of the time (3 of 7; each attack had a 68% chance); Aurel Crown hit 88% of the time (7 of 8; each attack had a 76-88% chance, about 81% on average).
Result: Aurel Crown won after 2 rounds: the enemy broke and fled.

Why: Aurel Crown's hits did about 3 more damage than average rolls would (mostly its Crossbowmen's hits), and Thornmane Clans' about 7 less; hit rates: Aurel Crown 88% (about 81% expected), Thornmane Clans 43% (about 68% expected); Aurel Crown's Crossbowmen shot over their own front rank, out of reach, for about 17 damage; even though Thornmane Clans' Fangthrowers skirmished past the front line to the Crossbowmen.
Aftermath: Thornmane Clans routed, and its army was destroyed as it fled (4 fighters lost; there are no retreats yet).
